name: Fantasy
description: Declarative fantasy preset. Rule-bound wonder; no living-author imitation.
purpose: Treat wonder as a system with prices, cultures, and political weight.
writing_goals: Establish what magic or myth can and cannot do
Let culture, ritual, and landscape carry history
Make power expensive in body, loyalty, or time
constraints: Do not imitate a living author
Use abstract narrative style, not a named living voice
Unpriced magic that solves the climax
A map dump that never returns as plot
checklist: Magic or mythic rules are stable
Place names and factions stay consistent
Prophecy or omen, if used, has a fair reading

pacing_tendency.value: quest or pressure-wave; travel must change knowledge or allegiance

description_tendency.value: tactile setting, named customs, weather and material culture

dialogue_tendency.value: status-marked speech; oaths and bargains matter
